grammar_note_vi: Mời ai: "Would you like to come to my party?" Nhận lời: "I'd love to!" Từ chối lịch sự: "I'm sorry, I can't. I have to..." Thư mở đầu bằng "Dear...", kết thúc bằng "Love from..." hoặc "Best wishes".

writing.target: Dear|Would you like to come to|Best wishes

text_en: Dear Nick, I'm having a fancy dress party for my birthday!
It's on Saturday, the twelfth of May, from three to six o'clock.
The party is at my house, 25 Lake Street.
There will be a magician, games and a big chocolate cake.
I'm going to be a dragon!
Let me know if you can come.
My phone number is on the back of the card.
